messages.subject: Boost bug report & patch for local return warning for iterators in C++11
parts:
Jeffrey Oldham has filed a Boost bug ticket for the local
return issue:

https://svn.boost.org/trac/boost/ticket/8489

He includes a patch to fix the problem on their side, but
so far, there's been no action on it, nor any reply to my
messages to the Spirit mailing list on the multiple unsequenced
issue.

As I was updating our to-do list, I realized that
Jeffrey's e-mail about the bug report went to Stan's e-mail
(which goes to me and Daniel), not our dev or user's list.

- Bob
